description: This file defines API endpoints for managing doctor profiles, including CRUD operations with role-based access control, using FastAPI and MongoDB.

methods.name: Doctor _doctor_from_doc(doc: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Converts a MongoDB doctor document to a `Doctor` model.

methods.name: None _assert_doctor_owner_or_admin(doc: Dict[str, Any], user_claims: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permissions to act on the doctor document; raises 403 if not.

methods.name: List[Doctor] list_doctors(_: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns a list of all doctor profiles.

methods.name: Doctor create_doctor( payload: DoctorCreate, user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Creates a new doctor profile, with role-based access control.

methods.name: Doctor get_doctor( doctor_id: str = Path(..., description="Doctor document id"), _: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific doctor profile by ID.

methods.name: Doctor update_doctor( doctor_id: str, payload: DoctorUpdate, user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Updates fields of a doctor profile, if authorized.

methods.name: None delete_doctor( doctor_id: str, _: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(role_required(["admin"])), )
methods.description: Deletes a doctor profile; only accessible to admin role.

ctags.name: _assert_doctor_owner_or_admin
ctags.pattern: /^async def _assert_doctor_owner_or_admin(doc: Dict[str, Any], user_claims: Dict[str, Any]) -> Non/

ctags.name: create_doctor
ctags.signature: ( payload: DoctorCreate, user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )

ctags.name: get_doctor
ctags.signature: ( doctor_id: str = Path(..., description="Doctor document id"), _: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )

ctags.name: list_doctors
ctags.pattern: /^async def list_doctors(_: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user)) -> List[Doctor]:$/

ctags.name: update_doctor
ctags.signature: ( doctor_id: str, payload: DoctorUpdate, user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
